text: the two providers disagree on tomorrow's high (Open-Meteo 9.6 °C vs wttr.in 8 °C) and on tonight's minimum (4.6 °C vs 3 °C); wttr.in's j1 feed publishes no daily precipitation total, so the 4.10 / 9.70 mm figures are Open-Meteo model sums from a single model run. Caveat: `precipitation_probability_max` is the highest hourly probability in the day, not the probability of measurable rain over 24 h, and the Sunday 9 November total is the least stable of the three days.
